text: dsh-file-ref 是面向 DSH Web 的文件引用插件：它在浏览器输入框处理非图片文件的粘贴和拖放，并在主机侧注册暂存接口及 agent 步骤钩子。插件会解析本机路径，必要时把副本放入工作区收件目录，再把工作区内的路径写成 @引用供会话现有工具读取。它适合需要在对话中引用 PDF、代码或其他本地文件的 Web 用户；需要 DSH web profile，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-file-ref adds local file references to the DSH web composer. Paste or drop a non-image file to insert its path; when the browser hides that path, a copy is staged in the workspace. Valid @relative paths are confirmed before an agent step. Requires the web profile; no API key.
想把本地 PDF 拖进 DSH 对话里引用。
怎么在网页输入框粘贴一份 CSV 文件？
让 DSH 能通过工作区路径读取我选的文件。
浏览器不显示文件原路径时，能否自动暂存副本？
我想把代码文件作为路径加到当前草稿中。
DSH Web 不接受普通文档文件，怎样在会话里引用它？
I want to drop a local document into the DSH web composer as a reference.
How can I paste a file into a DSH session without adding a separate file tool?
dsh-file-ref 的功能「粘贴和拖放本地文件」：用户在 DSH Web 输入框粘贴或拖入非图片文件时，插件解析可用的本机路径并将引用写入草稿；PNG、JPEG、WebP 和 GIF 仍走原有图片流程。
dsh-file-ref 的功能「暂存文件副本」：浏览器无法提供文件原路径且会话有工作区时，插件将文件内容发送到主机暂存接口，并在工作区收件目录创建副本供草稿引用。
dsh-file-ref 的功能「验证工作区引用」：在 agent 执行步骤前，插件扫描用户文本中的 @相对路径，确认路径存在于当前工作区后追加文件或目录引用标记。
dsh-file-ref 的功能「保留工作区外绝对路径」：能够解析到本机原始路径时，插件将其插入草稿；工作区内路径缩写为 @相对路径，工作区外路径保留为绝对路径文本。
dsh-file-ref 使用暂存流程时会把浏览器文件字节传到本机 DSH 主机，并在工作区的 inboxDir 下写入副本；默认目录为 .dsh-inbox，单个文件默认上限 20 MiB。

dsh-file-ref README · dsh-file-ref：Drag-and-drop or paste any local file — PDF, CSV, code, or document — into the DSH web composer. The plugin resolves the filesystem path and inserts an `@workspace` reference the agent opens with existing tools. No upload API, no extra model context.

dsh-file-ref README · Why do I need this?：Without this plugin, the DSH composer **only accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF**. Any other file is rejected as an unsupported image format.

`dsh-file-ref` bridges that gap:

- Recover the original filesystem path when the browser or host can see it.
- Otherwise write a copy into the workspace inbox and `@` that path.
- Mark `@relative` mentions before the model step so the agent can open the file with `read`, the shell, or other tools already in the session.
dsh-file-ref README · Why do I need this?：There is no new upload API and no extra model-facing file tool. The agent uses whatever access mode the session already provides.

dsh-file-ref README · Quick Start：Requires the `dsh` CLI and the `web` profile.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/auroralab-art/dsh-file-ref/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-file-ref-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh the browser. Done.

To remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-file-ref
```

dsh-file-ref README · How does it work?：| File location | Draft text inserted |
|---|---|
| Inside the current workspace | `@docs/spec.pdf` |
| Outside the workspace | `/Users/you/Downloads/spec.pdf` |
| Path hidden by the browser | `@.dsh-inbox/spec.pdf` (a copy under the workspace) |
| PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF | First-party image rail, unchanged |

Before a step, the host confirms each `@relative` path still exists and injects:

```xml
<workspace-reference path="docs/spec.pdf" kind="file" />
```
dsh-file-ref README · How does it work?：Absolute paths stay as typed. The plugin does not open the file or send its bytes. The agent reads the path with the session's usual tools and access mode.

dsh-file-ref README · How are file paths resolved?：- Paste and drop of PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF stay on the first-party image rail.
- A path inside the workspace is inserted as `@relative`. A path outside the workspace is inserted as absolute text.
- When the browser hides the filesystem path, the host writes a copy under `inboxDir` and the draft `@`s that relative path.
- Reference markers are created only from `@relative` tokens that still exist inside the workspace.
- Absolute paths stay as typed. The plugin does not rewrite them into mentions.
- File format does not change this flow. A staged copy must be within `maxStageBytes`.
- DSH `read` opens UTF-8 text. Other formats use the session's shell or other tools.

dsh-file-ref README · Configuration：Optional keys go in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. A later layer replaces the whole `config` object, so restate every key you set.

```yaml
- id: dsh-file-ref
  config:
    inboxDir: .dsh-inbox
    maxStageBytes: 20971520

| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `inboxDir` | `.dsh-inbox` | Workspace-relative directory for copies when the browser hides the original path |
| `maxStageBytes` | `20971520` (20 MiB) | Maximum size of one staged copy |

dsh-file-ref README · FAQ：
Does this upload files to the model? No. The plugin inserts a *path* into the composer text. The agent opens the file using the session's existing tools (`read`, shell, etc.). File bytes are never sent to the LLM context through this plugin.
What file formats are supported?

dsh-file-ref README · FAQ：All formats except PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF (which use the built-in image rail). Common use cases include PDF, CSV, JSON, YAML, source code, Markdown, and any text-based document.
Can I use this with headless mode? No. This plugin targets the `web` profile only, as it relies on browser paste/drop events and the composer UI.
What happens with large files?

dsh-file-ref README · FAQ：Files staged into the inbox are capped by `maxStageBytes` (default 20 MiB). The agent still needs to read the file through standard tools, so very large files may hit the session's own limits.
Which DSH version is required? Tested against DeepSeek Harness `v0.1.0-rc.1` and later. Plugin contracts may change between DSH preview releases — pin the version you test against.

dsh-file-ref README · Compatibility：| Requirement | Version |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | `v0.1.0-rc.1`+ |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` |
| Profile | `web` |

`add "$PWD"` links this checkout into the profile. Keep the directory. That is the development path, not the install command for other machines.
